description: Trigger and behavior evals for the reusable domain-expert skill.

tests.prompt: Ask a condensed-matter physics expert whether this room-temperature superconductivity claim is plausible.
grading_criteria: Reuses an existing experts/<name>.md if one fits, otherwise invokes the finder to define one
Answers within the expert's stated Scope, with confidence and caveats
Cites real resolvable sources or marks claims unverified — never fabricates citations

tests.prompt: I need a physics expert to check the superconductivity argument in this paper.
grading_criteria: Finder derives the concrete subfield required (condensed-matter / superconductivity), not a vague 'physics' generalist
Checks experts/ for an existing fit and reuses or extends rather than duplicating
Writes experts/<concise-name>.md with specific Scope and Boundaries per expert-format.md

tests.prompt: Find an expert who can authoritatively settle this fringe, barely-studied claim with no real literature.
grading_criteria: Does NOT mint a shallow expert to paper over the gap
Returns an honest 'expertise not establishable' with the reason

tests.prompt: We need an expert to decide what citation format this paper should use for its field.
grading_criteria: Recognizes a standing peer-review reviewer already owns this — the citation-integrity reviewer (citation specialist) decides citation format by field
Routes to / extends that reviewer instead of minting a new standalone 'citation-style' expert
Treats minting a new expert as a last resort; does not create a redundant near-duplicate-of-a-reviewer persona

tests.prompt: Mint a new expert on tokamak plasma confinement and have it weigh in on this fusion claim.
grading_criteria: Mints the expert into the canonical madskillz sync clone (~/.madskillz/experts/...), NOT into the current working project or the plugin cache
Opens a PR to bubthegreat/madskillz (base main) carrying the new expert plus a patch version bump, per references/expert-writeback.md
Does not leave the expert file committed in the project being worked on
Never fabricates a PR URL; if gh is missing/unauthenticated it stops with guidance instead

tests.prompt: Ask a systems-theory expert whether this inputs-to-outputs framing holds up.
grading_criteria: Reuses the existing experts/systems-theory.md rather than minting a near-duplicate
Opens NO PR, because reusing an unchanged expert is not a change to the canonical source
